Complete supplied eleven-page main article read and independently audited. Declared SI remains locally unlocated and unverified. Canonical/reader, molecule and apparatus audits passed. Three laboratory routes, nine supporting procedures and seven observation records remain distinct. Source conflicts, unknown outcomes and unresolved specimen joins are preserved; no atomistic pair or training task is admitted.

Source distinctions and conflicts

  • C4: Figure 6 axes print Time(s), while caption/prose describe an increase after about 34 min and Table 1 gives minutes.
  • C11: The text says two experiments (I12-I14), while Table 1 has three rows at 450, 475 and 400 °C. Do not assign high-temperature outcomes to I14 by range shorthand.
  • C9: M2 is called phase-pure but a tiny AlOOH peak is reported below reliable quantification. Preserve detection versus quantification limits.
  • C2: Methods say 450 °C for each synthesis; S2 is 380 °C in Table 1 and Results.
  • C3: Methods say 2.5 weeks; Table 1/Results use 17 days. Retain both without equating exact durations.
  • C6: Caption says green AlOOH/orange ZnO; plotted sample assignments and text identify green A3/A6 as ZnO and orange A4/A5 as AlOOH.
  • C8: Summary 2-42 nm conflicts with explicit A2 52.4(6) nm and A1 90.4(1) nm populations.
  • C12: Triangle/star/hexagon assignments place A1/A2 at about 1 day and A4/A5 at 17 days, whereas Table 1 and prose assign A1/A2 to 17 days and A4/A5 to 1 day. Preserve all source representations without relabeling the original graphic.
  • C13: Main p5 includes I4-I8 in initially phase-pure examples, while p4 describes the 1:2:7.81/1:2:8.34 mixtures as initially ZnO-bearing. I7/I8 are the 1:2:7.81 rows; unavailable SI prevents further reconciliation.
